data.what_it_does: Provides the web platform implementation for the google_maps_flutter plugin. It uses the Google Maps JavaScript API to render interactive maps inside Flutter web applications.
use_when: Building a Flutter web application that needs to display Google Maps
Using google_maps_flutter as an endorsed federated plugin which automatically includes web support
avoid_when: Building a mobile-only application that does not target the web
Needing features unsupported on the web version such as rotation, tilt, or lite mode
strengths: Endorsed federated plugin that works automatically with google_maps_flutter
Supports advanced markers, custom styling, and marker clustering
weaknesses: Certain features like compass, rotation, and tilt are unavailable due to web limitations
Requires manual addition of Google Maps JavaScript API script tags in web/index.html
data.setup_notes: Requires getting an API key for the Google Maps JavaScript API and adding the script tag to the web/index.html file.
